title: Kakawin Ramayana (Old Javanese Ramayana)
summary: The Kakawin Ramayana is an Old Javanese verse retelling of the Ramayana, written in the ninth century, probably in its second half. It is the oldest surviving Javanese kakawin and the only one to survive from the Central Javanese period, and it adapts a Sanskrit telling of the story.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com says "probably" the second half of the ninth century; Cornell's Indonesia journal says circa the ninth century; Creese says only that it dates from the ninth century. The range runs from 801 to 900.

as_recorded.value: probably written during the second half of the ninth century

importance.justification: The oldest surviving Javanese kakawin and a landmark in Old Javanese literature.
